description: The National Tunnel Inventory (NTI) records structural, operational and safety inspection data for public highway tunnels in the United States. State departments of transportation, federal agencies and tribal governments submit data to FHWA every year, and the inventory includes over 500 highway tunnel complexes on public roads. Each record carries the tunnel number and name, state, county and place, highway district, route number, direction and type, facility carried, linear referencing route and mile point, portal coordinates, border responsibilities and many further inspection items numbered as in the tunnel inventory specification. Coverage is national. The data are public domain, published on the US DOT data hub with 1,150 rows across reporting years, and available to download as CSV and other formats or through the Socrata API; rows were last updated in July 2026. Caveats: it is limited to highway tunnels on public roads, and its condition items are inspection ratings coded as in the inventory specification. FHWA uses it for federal oversight, safety management, risk-based maintenance forecasting and national reporting, and it supports exposure and criticality analysis of tunnels in road network models. It complements the National Bridge Inventory.
